item.title: AX: Google's orchestrator for AI agents on Kubernetes
item.description: In 2014 Google released Kubernetes to manage lots of containers across lots of hosts. Today it’s the de facto standard for running workloads. In 2026 Google released AX (Agent Executor) to manage lots of autonomous agents inside a Kubernetes cluster. Whether it becomes a standard too, only time will tell. AX is infrastructure for running AI workloads. It runs on top of Kubernetes and Agent Substrate, which provides the sandboxed execution.
